title: pv-dash metrics spec — the scraper's metric tree
description: The metrics spec the modbus-scraper --metrics-spec knob reads (scraper/examples/metrics.json is the shipped example; scraper/lib/metrics.json is the built-in one merged under it — the configured file's entries win by name): the SECTIONED form — "metrics" (the merged tree: one entry per metric, profile- or expr-fed — the exported name is <prefix>_<key>), "scraper" (the exporter's own observability, the keys verbatim) and "inputs" (the declared expression vocabulary: the reserved four pv/grid/batt/soc plus the spec's profile keys). The legacy flat form (one dict of full names, every entry carrying "help") is still accepted and schema'd here; the 'profile'/'compute' section names are gone (the entries live in one "metrics" tree). The schema documents the blessed shape — the loader (scraper/lib/metrics.py's Metrics) stays the strict word and checks what a schema cannot: the profile register existing, the expr/when compiling over the declared inputs, the reserved-input declarations, a register bound twice.

additionalProperties.description: The input's declaration: {help} — the wording the show metrics inputs report carries; the loader ignores extra keys here.

inputs.description: The declared expression vocabulary: the reserved four must be declared (the built-in lib/metrics.json ships their wording); a name the spec cannot feed refuses.

metrics.description: The metric tree: the exported name is <metric-prefix>_<key>.

type.description: The Prometheus type word (the exposition; the loader defaults it to gauge).

scraper.description: The exporter's own observability: the keys ARE the exported names (the fixed scraper_ prefix). These entries are fed by the exporter's internals and the mapping file (the profile register -> the catalog key wiring) — they carry no profile/expr fields of their own.

oneOf.description: The legacy flat form: one dict of full export names.

profile.description: The device-profile register the metric reads (the loader checks it exists).

type.description: The Prometheus type word (the exposition; the loader defaults it to gauge).

oneOf.description: The profile-fed entry: read straight from the poller's canonical register.

expr.description: The formula over the declared inputs (lib/expr.py's grammar), compile-checked at startup — one compute metric cannot feed another.

when.description: The presence gate: an expression over the same inputs; false/absent keeps the metric out of the exposition.

type.description: The Prometheus type word (the exposition; the loader defaults it to gauge).

oneOf.description: The compute entry: derived per poll from the declared inputs.
